text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we work. One major benefit is automation, which handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling, freeing employees for more creative work. Productivity tools, such as smart email filters and meeting summarizers, help us save hours each week. However, this does not mean human jobs will disappear. Instead, we see human-AI collaboration, where people oversee AI outputs, make final decisions, and provide emotional intelligence. While some job roles will change or require new skills, many new positions will emerge, such as AI trainers or ethics officers. Adapting through continuous learning is key to thriving in this new environment.
